profiles.why_not: the RUC land surface (sf_surface_physics = 3) cannot be initialised from the soil --source gem-gdps publishes, so its preparation would download the cycle and then refuse: mapped soil declares 1 source layer(s) ((0.0, 0.1),); the RUC layer arm needs at least two.  init_soil_3_real:1938-1943 builds the 0 m moisture anchor by extrapolating off the top TWO layers and with one layer reads sm_input(3) uninitialised, so there is no WRF behaviour to reproduce -- and a single shallow slab does not carry the 3 m of soil column LSMRUC integrates
